proposal.description: hiccup_timer's cool-down counter is sized from the default 5 ms base instead of the largest legal host-written base (HICCUP_BASE_MAX_CLKS), which is the sizing mistake the package warns against
proposal.reason: Suppose the host writes a hiccup base above about 10.5 ms, which is legal up to 20 ms. On a strike of 1 or more, base<<strike_level then overflows the 20-bit target and wraps to a smaller value, so the cool-down ends early and En comes back on before the commanded interval.

proposal.description: fault_cause's RUN overcurrent input is wired to the soft-start window trip, so both of its overcurrent inputs carry window_trip_SS and a RUN window trip is never logged
proposal.reason: When an overcurrent window trip in S_RUN sends the converter into hiccup, the overcurrent bit of FAULT_CAUSE is not set and no episode timestamp is latched. A host read then shows an empty or incomplete fault record. Soft-start trips are still logged.
